snippet: - HPA shows `<unknown>/50%` for CPU - Pod count stays at minReplicas despite high load - `kubectl describe hpa` shows "unable to get metrics"

title: Skillcheck: Linux Fundamentals
aliases: apt dpkg filesystem journalctl linux linux-basics permissions rpm services systemctl units yum
snippet: Linux is a **kernel** that offers **syscalls**. Everything else (shell, systemd, tools) sits on top. Most "Linux problems" reduce to: **permissions**, **namespaces**, **process state**, **filesystem state**, or **resource pressure**.

title: Skillcheck: Bash
aliases: advanced-bash bash scripting shell shell-scripting
snippet: Bash takes text and does **parsing** + **expansions** + **word splitting** + **globbing**, then execs programs. Most Bash bugs are: **unquoted expansions**, **IFS/whitespace**, or **subshell scope**.

title: Skillcheck: Docker
aliases: containers docker-compose dockerfile images
snippet: Containers are just **processes** with **namespaces** (isolation) and **cgroups** (limits). Images are **layers** stacked by a union filesystem.

snippet: Terraform builds a **dependency graph**, then compares **desired config** vs **state** vs **real APIs** to create a plan. Your biggest risks are **state**, **drift**, and **blast radius**.

snippet: Ansible is: **controller** connects over **SSH/WinRM**, transfers a **module**, runs it, and returns structured results. Idempotency comes from **modules knowing state**, not from "shell scripts".

aliases: branching merging rebase version-control
snippet: Git is a **content-addressed object database** plus **refs** (names) that point at commits. A commit points to a tree (directory snapshot) which points to blobs (file content).

snippet: **Git is the single source of truth.** An in-cluster controller (ArgoCD/Flux) watches Git, compares desired state to live state, and reconciles continuously. Changes flow through **pull requests**, not `kubectl apply`.

aliases: cncf k8s-landscape kubernetes-ecosystem

snippet: RBAC controls **who** can act. Policy engines control **what** can exist. They enforce organizational standards at the API admission level using webhooks.

snippet: **SLIs** measure user experience. **SLOs** set targets. **Error budgets** create objective tradeoffs between reliability and velocity. **Postmortems** turn incidents into organizational learning.

snippet: K8s Secrets are **base64**, not encrypted. Real secrets management **encrypts** secrets before they enter Git or the cluster, uses **external stores** as the source of truth, and **rotates** credentials automatically.
